_readme: Manifest of expected columns for schemaGuard-only tables — tables that have a CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guard in schemaGuard.ts or db-migrate.ts but have NO corresponding Drizzle pgTable definition in lib/db/src/schema/. The schema-guard-column-diff script reads this file and checks that every listed column actually appears in the CREATE TABLE body across both guard files. If a column is listed here but absent from the CREATE TABLE body, CI exits 1 — the developer forgot to add the column to the CREATE TABLE. HOW TO USE: when you add a new column to application code for a schemaGuard-only table, (1) add the column to the CREATE TABLE body in schemaGuard.ts / db-migrate.ts, AND (2) add it to the list for that table below. Example entry: "my_table": ["id", "status", "created_at"]. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the script.
